lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular blobs are arranged in a multi-tiered grid posterior to the gill slits. The primary nodes form two distinct horizontal rows with a consistent inter-blob spacing of approximately 1.5 to 2 blob-diameters.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of higher pixel intensity are visible, intersecting the horizontal rows to create a lattice where the most intense blobs serve as the vertices of the grid.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant linear feature runs horizontally across the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition from a light dorsal edge to a shadowed ventral edge, extending from the posterior head toward the tail.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a small teleost fish (remora) attached to the posterior edge of the right pectoral fin, and several others swimming in the immediate proximity of the gill slits and ventral flank.
